Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to pull together a concise MAP so we can close the GCP private offer and route billing to our central finance org. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm the exact billing path you can support (invoicing cadence and payer change timing).
- Legal redline window & who on your legal team will own the DocuSign routing.
- SOC2 evidence and any additional audit artifacts we need to attach in the purchase order.

I've attached a first-pass PO (CloudX_PO_Draft_v1.pdf) and a spreadsheet with our internal billing labels. Can you and your team put together a sprint-style checklist (2-week cadence preferred) with single owners for each item?

Goal: get to signature by 2028-06-30. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Martha

- Week 2 (6/25–6/30):

Hi Martha — looping in legal/ops context.

We reviewed the CloudX_PO_Draft_v1.pdf. Two quick legal items to flag:

1) Payment terms: the PO requests Net45; Redwood standard is Net30. We can accept Net45 but need a billing statement cadence in the PO (monthly invoices preferred).
2) Data processing addendum: CloudX included a customized clause on subprocessor controls. Our Data Protection Officer needs to approve; that may require a short call.

To keep the sprint clean, proposed immediate actions:
- Martha / CloudX: confirm the final payer entity name and billing contact (required by 6/21).
- CloudX: confirm Net45 or move to Net30 (you indicated Net45 in doc — please confirm).
- Redwood (law): I will prepare a tracked-redline DocuSign envelope and send to Martha for review by 6/22.

I will also upload our redline to the Drive link and initiate DocuSign routing once we have payer confirmation. If we hit the Net45 ask with no other redlines, 6/30 signature is still realistic. If additional DPA changes are requested, factor +3 business days.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
